notes.title: Cards, Achievement, Linux and OS X support.
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I just updated the game and added:
- Trading Cards!
- [b]Achievement[/b] for finishing the game.
- [b]Linux[/b] and [b]OS X[/b] support.
- Minor bug fixes, thanks for your help with finding them!

Thanks for the love.

And yeah, [b]Trading Cards[/b] should arrive within 1-2 days!
